note: Part of the production family: buildings, construction, repairs, conversion and the capacity lines of wing-ships and ritual grounds. Terms come from the glossary (construction = Works, civilian factory = Guild Workshop, railway = High Road, aircraft = Flier); the building window is the works, a slot is a slot, a barred march stands for the demilitarised zone.
